currentFormal.prerequisite: announcementsVerified===true is required by the preceding FINANCIAL_SOURCE_COMPLETENESS bundle
currentFormal.expression: (officialAnnouncements || []).some(title => /停止交易|重大損失|重整|退票|財報不實/.test(title))
currentFormal.lookback: ANNOUNCEMENTS validator retains rows with announcementDate in [scanDate-30 calendar days, scanDate]
currentFormal.storedCoverageText: 本次官方重大訊息清單，非全面新聞或全部歷史訂單

sourceReadinessFindings: The sync script fetches both public endpoints and requires HTTP success before POSTing quality data.
The Worker validator itself receives payload arrays through the trusted quality-data ingestion boundary; endpoint strings are validated but the server does not independently fetch those URLs.
ANNOUNCEMENTS has no minimum event-count or per-market row-count acceptance floor. Two empty arrays are structurally compatible with sourcesVerified=true and count=0.

Zero events can be legitimate, so empty payload is not automatically a source failure. The evidence problem is that the persisted snapshot does not preserve transport status/body hashes/raw per-market counts needed to distinguish a witnessed empty official response from a merely trusted empty injection later.
sourcesVerified is scan-global and is assigned to every stock; it is not per-symbol coverage.
Existing quality snapshot storage is mutable by marketDate and readQualitySnapshot returns snapshot JSON rather than an immutable first-known ingestion receipt.

lexicalGateFalsification.representation: literal title substring regex only; no negation, resolution state, category id or semantic classifier

fixedCounterexamples.title: 澄清：本公司並無重大損失
重整計畫執行完畢，恢復正常營運
本公司股票自明日起停止買賣

lexicalGateFalsification.interpretation: These counterexamples prove representation incompleteness, not economic harm. Current veto may still protect against severe events and must not be relaxed without PIT/OOS outcome evidence.

denominator.formalReach: Only symbols that positively clear all prior Formal gates through FINANCIAL_SOURCE_COMPLETENESS and for which ANNOUNCEMENT_RISK is evaluable.
denominator.eventRiskFail: At least one retained 30-day officialAnnouncements title matches the exact deployed regex.
denominator.emptySetPass: Verified source plus no matching retained per-symbol event rows is Formal PASS under current semantics.
denominator.unknown: Snapshot/source lineage incomplete, observer version mismatch, or parent Formal reach not positively established.

evidenceBoundary: Historical outcome inference remains closed where first-known source/ingestion lineage is not immutable.
Do not infer gate marginal value from first-failure counts.
Do not broaden or narrow regex from synthetic examples alone.
Do not equate 30-day presence with unresolved risk; event resolution is not encoded.
exactNext: Freeze a prospective announcement receipt with source fetch time/status/hash, raw TWSE/TPEx row counts, retained 30-day count, per-symbol event ids/titles/dates, parent generation and exact deployed regex version.
Keep lexical-match state separate from event semantic category/resolution state.
Only after CLEAN prospective dates mature compare matched-veto versus upstream-clear nonmatched controls with event severity and market/regime controls.
